净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Shorter-duration drawdown stress adjusted by volatility. Uses 10-day rolling max and 10-day ATR to capture more responsive drawdown depth, summed over 5 days. Preserves parent's payoff mechanism while aiming to improve predictive IC/RankIC by reacting more quickly to recent peaks. This compact mutation changes only the lookback windows, keeping the core economic intuition intact.

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

-(ts_sum(5, (close / rolling_max(close,10) - 1) / true_range(10)))
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：ts_max(close) → 窗口 10 的滚动最大值 (与m_max相同)
  2. 步骤2：divide(close, v1(ts_max)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  3. 步骤3：subtract(v2(divide), 1) → 减法：x - y
  4. 步骤4：subtract(high, low) → 减法：x - y
  5. 步骤5：subtract(high, pre_close) → 减法：x - y
  6. 步骤6：abs(v5(subtract)) → 计算绝对值
  7. 步骤7：subtract(low, pre_close) → 减法：x - y
  8. 步骤8：abs(v7(subtract)) → 计算绝对值
  9. 步骤9：maximum(v6(abs), v8(abs)) → 逐点取两序列较大值
  10. 步骤10：maximum(v4(subtract), v9(maximum)) → 逐点取两序列较大值
  11. 步骤11：ts_mean(v10(maximum)) → 窗口 10 的滚动均值 (与m_avg相同)
  12. 步骤12：divide(v3(subtract), v11(ts_mean)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  13. 步骤13：ts_sum(v12(divide)) → 窗口 5 的滚动求和 (与m_sum相同)
  14. 步骤14：neg(v13(ts_sum)) → 返回-x

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 rolling_max：close.滚动窗口(10, min_periods=10).max()
  2. 计算 drawdown：(close / rolling_max) - 1.0
  3. 计算 high：high.values.astype(np.float64)
  4. 计算 low：low.values.astype(np.float64)
  5. 计算 close：close.values.astype(np.float64)
  6. 计算 atr：pd.Series(talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=10), index=df_copy.index)
  7. 计算 atr：atr
  8. 计算 normalized_dd：drawdown / atr
  9. 计算 factor：normalized_dd.滚动窗口(5, min_periods=5).sum()
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_vol_adj_stress_short(df): df_copy = df.copy() rolling_max = df_copy["str">'close'].rolling(10, min_periods=10).max() drawdown = (df_copy["str">'close'] / rolling_max) - 1.0 high = df_copy["str">'high'].values.astype(np.float64) low = df_copy["str">'low'].values.astype(np.float64) close = df_copy["str">'close'].values.astype(np.float64) atr = pd.Series(talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=10), index=df_copy.index) atr = atr.replace(0.0, np.nan) normalized_dd = drawdown / atr factor = normalized_dd.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum() df_copy["str">'factor_drawdown_vol_adj_stress_short'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_drawdown_vol_adj_stress_short']
